items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: Well, probably he's got one or two women like old man Glennie. Well, he heard about that. He knew all about it.

ctx.x: but who plays it though, Mr. Sire,

they can't get nobody to play it, and this car drill, it's got about nine parts to it, nine parts, the first thing that comes out, is grab your partner, grab your lady, grab your friend, then they're going to, start at the band, starts, bump, bump, bump, bump, bump, . hit the drum pair, boom. Then the ladies go and get their men and they all get in one line. And the men's on one side, the ladies on one side, and they're all in the whole hallway, in the economy hall. And that's where they started dancing. That's…
That one place you mentioned where your brother played was at Hammonds? Hammonds. Hammonds. Hannah. Yes, sir.
